title: sinwan-ui registry item
description: Shape of `public/r/<name>.json`, generated by `sinwan-ui build`. Mirrors `RegistryItem` and `isRegistryItem` in `sinwan-ui/src/registry/schema.ts`.

name.description: Item name used by `sinwan-ui add`, e.g. `button`, `utils`, `use-mobile`.

dependencies.description: npm specifiers with a version range, e.g. `sinwan-ui-core@^1.0.0`, `echarts@^6.1.0`. `sinwan` is a peer of the app and never listed.

devDependencies.description: npm specifiers installed as dev dependencies.

registryDependencies.description: Other items this item needs: a bare name (same registry), `@namespace/name` (a registry configured in `sinwan-ui.json`), or a full URL.

docs.description: Notes printed after the item is added.

cssVars.description: CSS custom properties per scope, e.g. `{ "light": { "primary": "oklch(...)" }, "dark": { ... } }`.

path.description: Path relative to the consumer alias directory for `type`, e.g. `button.tsx` or `select/select.tsx`.

content.description: Full file source, with cross-item imports in canonical alias form (`@/components/ui/<x>`, `@/lib/utils`, `@/hooks/<x>`).
